items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I renewed my friendship at the convention.

ctx.x: Incidentally, I was told about Basie when I started booking and when I got a date with him I found out that he was certainly a fine man to do business with, because the kind of band that he had, he played for the people.

Well, I worked with Basie Gibbens' band when I first came back from Count Basie's band, 1948; I worked the whole summer with him, and I still enjoyed a great friendship with Basie Gibbens; Elmer is his real name.
I renewed my friendship at the convention.
